TableOfContentsRoot.description: A `<nav>` that follows which section of the document is being read and marks the link to it. The sections are the targets of the fragment links inside it. Label it with `aria-label`.

props.activeId: The id of the section to mark. Pass it with `onActiveChange` to decide which link is marked yourself.
props.onActiveChange: Called with the id of the new active section when the scroll position names another one or a link is clicked; `undefined` before the first heading reaches the line.
props.offset: How far below the top of the scroll container a heading counts as reached, in px: the height of a sticky header. Keep the headings' `scroll-margin-top` no larger.
props.container: The element that scrolls the sections. Without it, the page's own scroll is followed.

TableOfContentsLink.description: A fragment link to one section. It carries `aria-current="location"` while its section is active; clicking it makes it active at once.

props.href: `#` and the id of the section's heading: `"#install"`.

dataAttributes.data-active: Present while the link's section is active.

TableOfContentsIndicator.description: A decorative element that follows the active link, placed with CSS variables measured against the root. Place it inside the root and give the root `position: relative`. It is rendered only while a link is active.

cssVariables.--active-link-top: The active link's top edge, from the root's padding box.
cssVariables.--active-link-left: The active link's left edge, from the root's padding box.
